section.div: Improved VGG-Unet model, which does segmentation and classification task of skin-lesion images.
This project features TensorFlow implementations using VGG-16, ResNet50 architectures for UNet, SegNet models, achieving a remarkable 95% segmentation accuracy on Cityscapes and KITTI datasets.
